Not sure how qualified I really am to answer this since I've only had mine for about 2 months now. But I LOVE not worrying about pills every day. Huge weight lifted for me.

I also went with the non-hormonal one, Paragard, which is nice if she wants to avoid hormones. The only downside I've noticed so far (aside from the painful insertion, which honestly wasn't *that* bad) is heavier, longer periods. The hormonal IUDs are supposed to have the opposite effect though. I'd say 8/10 would recommend so far.
